g.text: Four lenses, weighed by the stage

text.tspan: Direction — to the checkpoint goal and to the stage goal
picture N−1 → N, devlogs and artifacts in full,
picture 0 → 4, all four directions in a row,
tasks proven, cut, reworded on day 15

g.text: A picture is written by the platform, never by the AI, and always — whoever the curator is
A picture keeps ids, names and counts; what an artifact or a medium shows lives in its read, never copied into the picture
Picture 0 holds the author's inputs when listed, else everything the project has; a new project gives a near-empty one
Counters are stored as totals; the period's numbers are the difference of two pictures
The tasks and the evidence decide the AI's verdict; the lenses and the direction explain it
One pipeline for both curators: the AI writes it, the human says it on the call and the notes take the same shape
A human curator chooses the verdict freely; the modal warns on every task without evidence
